heaviest_rainfall.status: Record amounts of rain fell over 33.6 hours today with a total accumulation of 23.98mm.  It fell at 9.4 mm per hour at times and ranked 7th from our records.  The largest amount of rain ever recorded is on 09 November 2025 when 47.89mm fell at a maximum rate of 24.6mm per hour over the 144.8 hour event.

heaviest_rainrate.status: The rain rate reached 34.3mm per hour on 02 September 2025, and resulted in 21.19mm of rain over 15.0 hours.  This is the highest rate recorded by our weather station.

longest_rain.status: A storm today ranked 5th for the longest continuous rainfall according to our records, lasting a total of33.6 hours.  It came with 23.98mm of rainfall, at times, falling at 9.4mm per hour.  On 09 November 2025, the rain lasted for 144.8 hours, which is the longest time recorded by our database.  47.89mm accumulated and it fell at 24.6mm per hour at times.
